_comment: Items Emile is selling. Claude writes this file from photos sent in chat; the page reads it. Status taps on the page are saved per-device in localStorage and override whatever is here, so the 'status' below is just the starting point.

items.title: Folk check flannel overshirt
items.listing_title: Folk Check Flannel Overshirt Green/Tan - Size 4 (L)
items.listing_description:
Folk brushed flannel overshirt in a green, tan and grey check, size 4 (Folk's own numbered sizing - roughly a UK L, check their size guide against your usual fit).

Condition: very good, no rips, stains or missing buttons. Two patch chest pockets, standard collar, single button cuffs.

Measurements taken flat:
- Pit to pit: [measure before listing]
- Length from collar seam: [measure before listing]

From a smoke-free home. Posted tracked within one working day.
items.notes: You said Folk/Edwin pieces sat unsold even under £30 last time - that points to thin demand for these brands on Vinted rather than a pricing problem, so cutting further isn't guaranteed to fix it on its own. Priced at £22 to actually test whether price was ever the real lever. If this doesn't move within a couple of weeks either, the more useful fixes are probably: broader title keywords (buyers search 'flannel overshirt' more than 'Folk'), a couple more photos (worn/styled, not just on a hanger), or cross-posting to eBay for a different buyer pool - not going lower still.

items.title: Nudie Jeans denim trucker jacket
items.listing_title: Nudie Jeans Denim Trucker Jacket - Men's L
items.listing_description:
Nudie Jeans denim trucker jacket in indigo, size L, dry rigid-style cotton denim (the inside tag reads 'Dry Ring 100% Cotton'). Twin chest pockets, copper buttons.

Condition: good - some natural fading at the collar and cuffs consistent with light wear on raw denim, no rips or repairs.

Measurements taken flat:
- Pit to pit: [measure before listing]
- Length from collar seam: [measure before listing]

From a smoke-free home. Posted tracked within one working day.
items.notes: Nudie no longer sells denim trucker jackets new (their current jacket range is leather/wool/canvas) so this is a discontinued style, which can help it stand out to Nudie collectors. Don't call it 'Billy' in the listing title - that's the fabric batch name on the tag, not a jacket model, and using it could read as a specific product claim you can't back up. Nudie denim has strong resale demand generally (you've seen that yourself on the buying side), so unlike the Folk/Edwin pieces this one's more likely to move at a fair price rather than needing a rock-bottom one.

items.title: Folk oatmeal wool chore jacket
items.listing_title: Folk Wool Chore Jacket Oatmeal - Men's M
items.listing_description:
Folk chore jacket in oatmeal wool, size M. Buttoned front, chest patch pocket, two large lower patch pockets.

Condition: new without tags - looks unworn, no marks, bobbling or fading.

Measurements taken flat:
- Pit to pit: [measure before listing]
- Length from collar seam: [measure before listing]

From a smoke-free home. Posted tracked within one working day.
items.notes: Folk's wool outerwear retails £230-325 new, so £88 is a strong discount - but you've had two other Folk pieces sit unsold at much lower prices, so treat that as a real signal about how thin the Vinted market is for this brand specifically, not just about those two items. Give this a fair chance at £88 since it's new-without-tags and a genuinely different price bracket, but if it hasn't moved in a couple of weeks, a photo/title refresh will probably do more than a further price cut. Looks unworn in the photos - if it genuinely never had tags on, say 'new without tags' rather than 'never worn', which is the more defensible claim.
